title: Tenses and Verb Patterns — Level 10 — Final challenge

items.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a trip to Ijen.

visual.text: We had already booked a guide before we arrived at Ijen.

choices.say: We had already booked a guide before we arrived at Ijen.

visual.text: We have already booked a guide before we arrived at Ijen.

choices.say: We have already booked a guide before we arrived at Ijen.

visual.text: We had already book a guide before we arrived at Ijen.

choices.say: We had already book a guide before we arrived at Ijen.

visual.text: We had already booked a guide before we arrive at Ijen yesterday.

choices.say: We had already booked a guide before we arrive at Ijen yesterday.

items.reteach: Kejadian yang lebih dulu di masa lalu memakai past perfect (had + V3).

items.prompt: "I have seen that film last night with my sister." Which part is kurang tepat?
items.reteach: "last night" = waktu lampau yang jelas, jadi pakai simple past: saw.

items.prompt: "My father has worked at this hospital since ten years." Which part is kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Lama waktu (ten years) memakai "for"; "since" untuk titik awal (since 2015).

items.prompt: "Every Sunday morning, my grandmother is going to the traditional market." Which part is kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Kebiasaan (every Sunday) memakai simple present: goes.

items.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a weekend plan.

visual.text: I've bought the paint; I'm going to repaint my room this weekend.

choices.say: I've bought the paint; I'm going to repaint my room this weekend.

visual.text: I've bought the paint; I will to repaint my room this weekend.

choices.say: I've bought the paint; I will to repaint my room this weekend.

visual.text: I've bought the paint; I going to repaint my room this weekend.

choices.say: I've bought the paint; I going to repaint my room this weekend.

visual.text: I've bought the paint; I'm going repaint my room this weekend.

choices.say: I've bought the paint; I'm going repaint my room this weekend.

items.reteach: Rencana yang sudah disiapkan memakai be going to + V1.

items.prompt: "She was knowing the answer, but she didn't say anything." Which part is kurang tepat?
items.reteach: "know" adalah stative verb, jadi tidak memakai -ing: she knew.

items.prompt: Choose the sentence with the correct V3 forms.

visual.text: The pond has frozen, and the pipes have burst.

choices.say: The pond has frozen, and the pipes have burst.

visual.text: The pond has froze, and the pipes have burst.

choices.say: The pond has froze, and the pipes have burst.

visual.text: The pond has frozen, and the pipes have bursted.

choices.say: The pond has frozen, and the pipes have bursted.

visual.text: The pond has freezed, and the pipes have burst.

choices.say: The pond has freezed, and the pipes have burst.

items.reteach: freeze–froze–frozen; burst–burst–burst.

items.prompt: "By the time the rescue team came, the climbers have walked down the mountain." Which part is kurang tepat?
items.reteach: "By the time + simple past" diikuti past perfect: had walked.

items.prompt: "Did you finished your project before the deadline yesterday?" Which part is kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Setelah "did", kata kerja memakai V1: Did you finish …?

items.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a habit that has stopped.

visual.text: My uncle used to drink sweet tea every night, but he stopped two years ago.

choices.say: My uncle used to drink sweet tea every night, but he stopped two years ago.

visual.text: My uncle is used to drink sweet tea every night, but he stopped two years ago.

choices.say: My uncle is used to drink sweet tea every night, but he stopped two years ago.

visual.text: My uncle use to drink sweet tea every night, but he stopped two years ago.

choices.say: My uncle use to drink sweet tea every night, but he stopped two years ago.

visual.text: My uncle used to drinking sweet tea every night, but he stopped two years ago.

choices.say: My uncle used to drinking sweet tea every night, but he stopped two years ago.

items.reteach: Kebiasaan lampau yang sudah berhenti: used to + V1.

items.prompt: "How long have you been knowing your best friend, Nadia?" Which part is kurang tepat?
items.reteach: "know" tidak dipakai dalam bentuk -ing: How long have you known …?

items.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a past modal.

visual.text: Yesterday I had to stay at home because of the flood.

choices.say: Yesterday I had to stay at home because of the flood.

visual.text: Yesterday I must stayed at home because of the flood.

choices.say: Yesterday I must stayed at home because of the flood.

visual.text: Yesterday I have to stay at home because of the flood.

visual.text: Yesterday I had to stayed at home because of the flood.

choices.say: Yesterday I had to stayed at home because of the flood.

items.reteach: Bentuk lampau "must/have to" adalah "had to + V1".

items.prompt: "Next Saturday our class will visits the Trowulan Museum." Which part is kurang tepat?
items.reteach: Setelah will selalu V1 tanpa -s: will visit.

items.prompt: Read the library notice. Why is the reading room closed this week?

stimulus.text: SMPN 5 Malang Library: We are renovating the reading room this week. It will reopen on Monday, 14 July. Until then, borrow books at the counter near the canteen.

items.reteach: Notice: "We are renovating the reading room this week."

items.prompt: Read the library notice. Where can students borrow books until 14 July?

stimulus.text: SMPN 5 Malang Library: We are renovating the reading room this week. It will reopen on Monday, 14 July. Until then, borrow books at the counter near the canteen.

visual.text: at the counter near the canteen

choices.say: at the counter near the canteen

items.reteach: Notice: "Until then, borrow books at the counter near the canteen."

items.prompt: Read the library notice. The word "reopen" in the notice means …

stimulus.text: SMPN 5 Malang Library: We are renovating the reading room this week. It will reopen on Monday, 14 July. Until then, borrow books at the counter near the canteen.

items.reteach: Awalan re- = lagi. reopen = buka kembali.

items.prompt: Read Raka's story. Which event happened before Raka reached the station?

stimulus.text: Last Sunday, Raka woke up late. By the time he reached the station, the train to Banyuwangi had left. He was sitting sadly on a bench when his aunt called with a new plan.

choices.say: His aunt called with a new plan.

visual.text: Raka was sitting on a bench.

choices.say: Raka was sitting on a bench.

visual.text: Raka felt sad on the bench.

choices.say: Raka felt sad on the bench.

items.reteach: "had left" (past perfect) menunjukkan kereta berangkat lebih dulu.

items.prompt: Read Raka's story. What was Raka doing when his aunt called?

stimulus.text: Last Sunday, Raka woke up late. By the time he reached the station, the train to Banyuwangi had left. He was sitting sadly on a bench when his aunt called with a new plan.

visual.text: He was sitting on a bench.

choices.say: He was sitting on a bench.

visual.text: He was getting on the train.

choices.say: He was getting on the train.

items.reteach: "He was sitting sadly on a bench when his aunt called."

items.prompt: Read Raka's story. Which verb shows an action in progress?

stimulus.text: Last Sunday, Raka woke up late. By the time he reached the station, the train to Banyuwangi had left. He was sitting sadly on a bench when his aunt called with a new plan.

items.reteach: was/were + V-ing = past continuous (sedang berlangsung).

items.prompt: Read the Class 8B trip plan. What is Class 8B going to do on Saturday?

visual.text: They are going to visit an apple farm.

choices.say: They are going to visit an apple farm.

visual.text: They have visited an apple farm.

choices.say: They have visited an apple farm.

visual.text: They are going to travel to Batu.

choices.say: They are going to travel to Batu.

items.reteach: Rencana minggu depan memakai be going to; Saturday = visit an apple farm.

items.prompt: Read the Class 8B trip plan. Which sentence about Sunday is correct?

visual.text: They will go home on Sunday.

choices.say: They will go home on Sunday.

visual.text: They have gone home on Sunday.

choices.say: They have gone home on Sunday.

visual.text: They will go to Batu on Sunday.

items.prompt: Read the Class 8B trip plan. When does Class 8B travel to Batu?
items.reteach: Judul tabel "next week" dan baris Friday = travel to Batu.

items.prompt: Read Nadia's message. What can we infer about Nadia?

stimulus.text: Hi Ayu! I've been learning Gandrung dance since May. I used to feel nervous on stage, but now I'm used to it. Our show will be on 17 August. See you there! Nadia

visual.text: She has become more confident on stage.

choices.say: She has become more confident on stage.

visual.text: She still feels very nervous on stage.

choices.say: She still feels very nervous on stage.

items.reteach: "I used to feel nervous … but now I'm used to it" = dulu gugup, sekarang sudah terbiasa.

items.prompt: Read Nadia's message. How long has Nadia been learning Gandrung dance?

stimulus.text: Hi Ayu! I've been learning Gandrung dance since May. I used to feel nervous on stage, but now I'm used to it. Our show will be on 17 August. See you there! Nadia

items.reteach: "have been learning … since May" = mulai Mei dan masih berlangsung.

items.prompt: Read Nadia's message. What is the main purpose of the message?

stimulus.text: Hi Ayu! I've been learning Gandrung dance since May. I used to feel nervous on stage, but now I'm used to it. Our show will be on 17 August. See you there! Nadia

visual.text: to share her progress and invite Ayu to the show

choices.say: to share her progress and invite Ayu to the show

visual.text: to ask Ayu to teach her dancing

choices.say: to ask Ayu to teach her dancing

items.reteach: Nadia bercerita tentang latihannya dan menulis "See you there!".

items.prompt: A: "Have you ever tried rujak cingur?" B: "Yes, I ___ it last month in Surabaya."
items.reteach: Ada waktu lampau yang jelas (last month), jadi simple past.

items.prompt: A: "Why are your shoes so muddy?" B: "I ___ in the rice field all afternoon."
items.reteach: Kegiatan yang baru berlangsung lama dan meninggalkan bukti: present perfect continuous.

items.prompt: A: "I can't carry all these books." B: "Wait, I ___ you."
items.reteach: Tawaran/keputusan spontan memakai will (I'll).

items.prompt: A: "What were you doing when the earthquake drill started?" B: "I ___ a science quiz."
items.reteach: Jawab pertanyaan past continuous dengan past continuous.

items.prompt: A: "Is Dimas still at school?" B: "No, he ___ home. He left ten minutes ago."
items.reteach: "has gone" = sudah pergi dan belum kembali; "has been" = pernah pergi lalu kembali.

items.prompt: A: "Have you been to Madura?" B: "Yes, I ___ there twice. The bridge is amazing."
items.reteach: Pengalaman pernah ke suatu tempat: have been to/there.

items.prompt: A: "What are your plans for the holiday?" B: "We ___ my grandparents in Banyuwangi. We've already bought the tickets."
items.reteach: Rencana yang sudah disiapkan memakai be going to.

items.prompt: Buyer: "Do you still have salak pondoh?" Seller: "Sorry, it ___ out. The last kilo went ten minutes ago."
items.reteach: "has just + V3" = baru saja terjadi.

items.prompt: Teacher: "Did you hand in your essay?" Student: "Not yet, Ma'am. I ___ it right now."
items.reteach: "right now" = sedang berlangsung: am + V-ing.

items.prompt: A: "How long ___ you ___ for the bus?" B: "About twenty minutes. It's late again."
items.reteach: Berapa lama sampai sekarang (masih menunggu): How long have you been waiting?

items.prompt: A: "When I was little, I ___ afraid of the dark." B: "Me too, but I'm not anymore."
items.reteach: Keadaan di masa lalu yang sudah berubah: used to + V1.

items.prompt: A: "Your English is great!" B: "Thanks! I ___ in Australia for two years before I moved back to Surabaya."
items.reteach: Kejadian sebelum kejadian lampau lain (moved back) memakai past perfect.

items.prompt: A: "I'm so tired after the long trip to Bromo." B: "Me too. I'm sure we ___ well tonight."
items.reteach: Prediksi pendapat ("I'm sure") untuk masa depan memakai will.

items.prompt: Odd one out: which verb does NOT end in "-ought" in its V2 form?
items.reteach: thought, brought, bought (-ought); catch → caught (-aught).

items.prompt: Analogy: go : went : gone = fly : ___ : ___
items.reteach: fly – flew – flown.

items.prompt: Analogy: "yesterday" is to the simple past as "since 2020" is to the ___.
items.reteach: "since + titik waktu" sampai sekarang memakai present perfect.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am a tense. My action started in the past and is still going on. I use has/have + been + V-ing. Who am I?
items.reteach: has/have + been + V-ing = present perfect continuous.

items.prompt: Code: P = present perfect, Q = past perfect, R = past continuous. "When I arrived, they had eaten. Mom was smiling." Which code matches "had eaten" and "was smiling" in order?
items.reteach: had eaten = past perfect (Q); was smiling = past continuous (R).

items.prompt: Odd one out: which sentence does NOT talk about the future?

items.reteach: "met" adalah simple past; tiga lainnya menyatakan masa depan.

items.prompt: Logic: "Rina had finished her homework before she ate dinner. She watched TV after dinner." Which happened FIRST?
items.reteach: Past perfect (had finished) menunjukkan kejadian paling awal.

items.prompt: Letter puzzle: unscramble "G-H-T-O-B-U" to get the V2 of "buy".
items.reteach: buy – bought – bought; "brought" (V2 bring) butuh huruf R.

items.prompt: Count the irregular verbs: walk, write, jump, speak, play, drink, open, take.
items.reteach: write, speak, drink, take = 4 irregular; walk, jump, play, open = regular.

items.prompt: The verb "lie" has two sets of forms. Going from "lie – lied – lied" to "lie – lay – lain", how does the meaning change?
items.reteach: lie–lied–lied = berbohong; lie–lay–lain = berbaring.

items.prompt: Timeline: "By 2020, Pak Hadi had taught at SMPN 1 Batu for 20 years. He retired in 2021." In which year did he start teaching there?
Analogy: "will" is to a future action as "used to" is to a ___.
items.reteach: "used to" menyatakan kebiasaan di masa lalu.

items.prompt: Riddle: I am a time word. I end the question "Have you finished ___?" but I never fit a positive simple past sentence. Who am I?
items.reteach: "yet" dipakai di kalimat tanya/negatif present perfect: Have you finished yet?
